facts.fact: The Minister for Communication and Information Technology's statement of 13 May 2026 cites the Tanzania Digital Economy Strategy Framework (2024-2034) as in force, so its stated period had not ended; the statement does not link or quote the text. Text public: not stated

systems.tiers: national; said to recognise digital transformation as a catalytic driver
national; recognises emergency telecommunications as a critical function
national; targets restoring communication services within 24 hours of a disaster

note: Class left empty for the Digital Economy Strategy Framework: the statement says only that it outlines measures to protect critical information infrastructure, data and information assets, and does not describe its overall scope. Adoption, plan and reporting are not stated.
